verdict:
The file is unusually good and most of it survives adversarial re-measurement, but it has one factually wrong safety claim, one incomplete free-text claim of exactly the enum class the brief warned about, three wrong roster figures, and a whole missing hazard family (hard-coded Adventure/JournalEntry/Item NAMES). Nothing I found breaks the extractor, the runtime layer, or the census arithmetic — all four defects are in the prose that tells a translator what not to touch, which in this project is the part that actually causes runtime breakage.
